headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 13, 2026**
article:
The Minnesota Twins took down the Baltimore Orioles 7-5 in a thrilling victory, with Dylan Beavers leading the Orioles' offense. The St. Louis Cardinals dominated the Philadelphia Phillies 7-1, with Alec Burleson contributing 2 hits and 3 RBIs. The Tampa Bay Rays secured an 8-4 win over the Athletics, led by Liam Hicks' 3 hits and 3 RBIs.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. Trevor McDonald was transferred to the 60-day injured list by the San Francisco Giants due to a right elbow strain. Garrett Whitlock was placed on the 15-day injured list by the Boston Red Sox with right elbow inflammation. James Outman was placed on the 7-day injured list by the Detroit Tigers with a concussion. Endy Rodríguez was placed on the 10-day injured list by the Pittsburgh Pirates with left hip inflammation. Jake Bloss was placed on the 60-day injured list by the Toronto Blue Jays. Riley Greene was placed on the 10-day injured list by the Detroit Tigers with a right hamstring strain. Kyle Karros was placed on the 7-day injured list by the Colorado Rockies with a concussion. José Suarez was placed on the 15-day injured list by the Athletics with a right hip strain.

Several teams made notable roster moves. The Baltimore Orioles acquired Harold Rivas from the Boston Red Sox. The Kansas City Royals acquired Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins. The Athletics acquired Seth Johnson from the Philadelphia Phillies. The Pittsburgh Pirates acquired Brandan Bidois, Brian Sanchez, and Hyun Seung Lee from the Miami Marlins in exchange for Lake Bachar.

top_news.title: **Twins Take Down Orioles in Thrilling 7-5 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins outlasted the Baltimore Orioles 7-5, securing a hard-fought win. Dylan Beavers led the Orioles' offense with a home run and three RBIs.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Cruise Past Phillies 7-1**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals dominated the Philadelphia Phillies, securing a 7-1 victory. Alec Burleson led the Phillies' offense with 2 hits, 3 RBIs, and 3 at-bats.

top_news.title: **Rays Take Down Athletics 8-4**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays secured an 8-4 victory over the Athletics, with Liam Hicks leading the charge at the plate. Hicks finished with 3 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs in 5 at-bats.

top_news.title: **Rockies Take Down Diamondbacks 6-4**
top_news.summary: The Colorado Rockies secured a 6-4 victory over the Arizona Diamondbacks, with Ryan Feltner earning the win. Brett Sullivan led the Rockies' offense with a home run, three RBIs, and one hit in four at-bats.

top_news.title: **Tigers Shut Out Guardians 3-0**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers secured a shutout victory over the Cleveland Guardians, winning 3-0. Impact players for the Tigers included Chase DeLauter, Eduardo Valencia, and Spencer Torkelson, while Parker Messick stood out on the mound.

top_news.title: **Reds Rally Past White Sox 9-8**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds secured a thrilling 9-8 victory over the Chicago White Sox, with multiple players contributing to the win. Impact hitters for the Reds included Sal Stewart, Tyler Stephenson, Eugenio Suárez, and Hunter Greene.

top_news.title: **Giants Update Trevor McDonald's Injury Status**
top_news.summary: San Francisco Giants right-handed pitcher Trevor McDonald has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a right elbow strain.

top_news.title: **Rivas Joins Orioles in Trade**
top_news.summary: Harold Rivas has been traded to the Baltimore Orioles as part of a deal involving the Boston Red Sox. The trade is related to the August 3 Adley Rutschman trade.
